title: Sleep Token - Wikipedia
notes: Read to character 100,000 of 124,429, for the persona, records and touring only. London, 2016; anonymous members united by worship of an ancient deity called 'Sleep'; II, drums and percussion, 2016 to present, the only member besides Vessel credited with songwriting; III (bass, touring, from 2017), IV (guitar, touring, from 2021), Espera (backing vocals, from 2024); on stage the members wear masks, long robes and black body paint; new masks revealed at Wembley Arena, December 2023; first shows 2017; first headline show St Pancras Old Church, 11 October 2018; Download Pilot headline 2021; Wembley Arena December 2023; US arena tour from September 2025; II at drum festivals in Europe in 2024 and 2025, a MixWave library of his touring gear in June 2025, and influences in British electronic music, drum and bass and drummers from metal and other genres. Genres listed: alternative metal, indie pop, progressive metal, post-metal, djent. Any identity speculation on the page was not read for or copied.

title: An Offering From Drumeo | Sleep Token II (Interview & Drum Playthroughs), Drumeo, 19 December 2023
notes: Also https://www.drumeo.com/beat/sleep-token-drummer-interview/. The band's first recorded video interview, with Brandon Toews; II in costume, voice altered; plays Vore, The Night Does Not Belong to God, Chokehold, Gods, Dark Signs, The Apparition, Atlantic, Alkaline, Like That, Rain, Take Me Back to Eden and Higher. From the captions and the article: 'I've always personally taken a lot of inspiration from the UK dance music scene ... various sub genres of drum and bass'; 'I'm also a big fan of R&B and pop'; 'I grew up primarily playing metal'; 'my vocabulary on the kit has expanded'; parts start from the vocal ('specific syllables that can benefit from accents on the kit', 'dance in between what's being sung') and from syncopations the drums must match; live parts 'vary drastically' from the records, but some (a guitar part, an electronic part on the pads) 'must remain true to the original'; favourite drummers Joey Jordison, the drummer of Mudvayne, Derek Roddy, then gospel players Tony Royster Jr., Eric Moore and Thomas Pridgen; 'a mixture of that signature Abe Cunningham, Deftones inspired, heavier sort of grooving' with a gospel influence; an eight-note linear phrase R L R L K R L K; a nine-note triplet phrase R L R K R L R K K 'three notes short of resolving'; the paradiddle as 'a chop starter'; the six-stroke roll 'whether it's groove or fill based'; Like That's parts 'my favorite that I've written'; Higher 'very interactive'; The Summoning's live solo. Drumeo lists DW Drums, Istanbul Agop cymbals, Wincent sticks.

title: The Iconic Drumming Behind 'The Summoning' | Sleep Token, Drumeo, 27 February 2024
notes: II explains and plays it. 'During a section on this song where specifically there are no drum parts I added a live addition of a drum solo'; 'a group of three notes played as right left kick; typically this would be counted as a triplet ... I'm effectively counting this as 16th notes, so I'm playing series and groups of three over a field of four, which gives the illusion of the voicing itself modulating'; also the eight-note sticking R L R L K R L K, 'twice through and the voicing changes with each repeat'.

title: The Iconic Drumming Behind 'Hypnosis' | Sleep Token, Drumeo, 17 September 2024
notes: II explains and plays it. The intro fill is 'a simple five note sticking ... right left right kick and ending with a flam on the snare'; 'during the final breakdown in this song the first half of this groove is played as straight eighth notes, then during the second half I switch to a dotted eighth note or dotted quaver lead hand ... after that it resolves itself and you land back on the one again'.

title: The Iconic Drumming Behind 'The Offering' | Sleep Token, Drumeo, 12 November 2024
notes: II explains and plays it. In the last eight bars of the final breakdown, a pattern between the china and the floor tom: his usual figure is R L L K, and here he takes away the left-hand double and plays single strokes, R L R K, in sixteenths across the group.

title: MixWave: Sleep Token - II (product page and user guide), June 2025
notes: User guide https://support.mixwave.com/doc/sleep-token-ii-user-guide; launch post 10 June 2025. 'Capturing every facet of Sleep Token's iconic drummer, II'; recorded by II at MixWave Studios. A four-piece DW Collectors Series kit with exotic hybrid shells: 22x18 kick (maple/mahogany), 10x7 rack tom (maple/mahogany), 12x8 rack tom and 16x16 floor tom (cherry/mahogany); snares 13x6.5 Craviotto Custom Shop steam-bent cherry, 13x6 DW Collectors maple/walnut/maple edge, 13x6.5 DW Collectors steel. Istanbul Agop: 13-inch Traditional Medium hats; 17-inch Traditional Dark, 18-inch OM, 16-inch Xist Ion and 19-inch Xist Dry Dark Brilliant crashes; 22-inch Idris Muhammad ride; stacks of a 10-inch Traditional Mini China over a 10-inch Turk Splash and an 18-inch Xist Ion crash over a 16-inch Turk China; 8-inch Xist splash, 10-inch Trash Hit, 18-inch Turk China; stick clicks. A commercial library: not freely licensed.
